Alex Nguyen: Quick ping — PR 24790 needs merge before maintenance at 22:00 UTC. Blocked by a flaky integration on mac and missing LAX CI artifacts from last run. Can someone with mac-matrix eyes retrigger? Failing test is `tests/integration/db_migrate_test` step 3.
Evan Park: On it — triggering rerun in LAX now. @ci-bot can you prioritize this? :raised_hands:
ci-bot: CI queued: rerun for PR 24790 on `lax-matrix` with priority=high. Build id: 8642.
Maya Singh: If it flakes again we'll probably need to rebase on `main`. I can take the rebase if it passes — leaving a note.
Sam Ortiz: I'll watch the logs. If we get artifacts uploaded to S3 path `s3://redwood-ci/pr-24790/` I can pull them for a quick binary diff.
Evan Park: Artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-ci/pr-24790/build-8642/
Alex Nguyen: Thanks! Note: avoid merges during the maintenance blackout 21:50–22:10 UTC. Prefer landing before 21:45 or after 22:10. Can we aim for 21:30 to have buffer?
Jordan Lee: 21:30 works for me — @Maya can you approve once CI goes green?
Maya Singh: Will approve on green, will post an approval comment. :white_check_mark:
ci-bot: Build 8642 status: PASSED — integration flake resolved. Artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/pr-24790/build-8642/
Alex Nguyen: Sweet. Wait 2 minutes for stability then merge. Sam/Jordan keep an eye for errors for 10m after merge.
Sam Ortiz: Merging now: `git merge --no-ff pr/24790` and pushing.
Sam Ortiz: Merged and pushed. Triggered deployment job: `deploy-2026-03-18-2135`.
deploybot: Deploy started (prod canary 1/5). Watch: https://ci.redwood.example/deploy/2026-03-18-2135 — automatic rollback if latency >200ms in 5m.
Jordan Lee: Canary looks healthy so far, no trace regressions.
Maya Singh: Approved earlier — great work team :tada:
